transcript.text: Hey everyone, welcome back to the channel. Today we're diving into video editing.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Um, so basically what most creators struggle with is, uh, pacing and audience retention.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: If your hook doesn't grab attention in the first three seconds, viewers will simply swipe away.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I mean, you know, we've all seen videos that drag on with endless pauses.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: We've all seen videos that drag on with endless pauses and unnecessary filler words.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That's why cutting out dead air and tightening your speech is the single biggest growth lever.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Let's look at how AI can automatically analyze your raw five minute footage.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It spots every um, ah, and awkward silence without you having to scrub manually.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Then it reframes your horizontal shot to a crisp vertical 9:16 layout.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: And burns dynamic kinetic captions with colorful highlighted keywords.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Make sure to test this workflow on your next reel and let me know your thoughts.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
